name: Obelus
summary:
**Enter Obelus, an otherworldly realm of floating islands where magic comes to life entirely through hand tracking.**

No controllers. No buttons. **Draw every spell with your own fingers.** Trace symbols through the air to unleash magical attacks, and discover new abilities as you grow stronger. More powerful spells demand increasingly complex patterns, precision, and practice.
